title: Concept: clientaccesspolicy.xml permits every origin
description: Client access policies are the Silverlight counterpart of crossdomain.xml, and a wildcard there is the same grant: any origin can read this host through the plugin bridge. Enterprises that removed the plugins still leave these files behind, and they remain a reliable marker of an allow-all posture.
applicability: Responses that serve clientaccesspolicy.xml from the web root.
risk: Any origin reads authenticated responses from this host through a client that honours the policy.
